functional_semantics.triton: Flat NCHW input; out = max over k x k taps at oh*stride+kh-padding, ow*stride+kw-padding with out-of-plane taps -inf; H_out/W_out floor formula; flat output (impl_triton.py 29-46, 64-66, 71).
functional_semantics.cutile: Same: (N*C, H, W) view, gather with padding_value=-inf for any out-of-range coordinate, same H_out/W_out, flat output written through an (N*C, H_out, W_out) view (impl_cutile.py 37-47, 55-57, 62-64).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise F.max_pool2d(input.view(N,C,H,W), k, stride, padding).reshape(-1) (impl_torch.py 6-8); both return an empty tensor when total_out <= 0 (unreachable in the sweep).

stages.triton: torch.empty flat output (71) then one kernel launch over (N*C, ceil(H_out/rows), ceil(W_out/cols)) (impl_triton.py 73-102).
stages.cutile: torch.empty flat output (62), 3-D views (63-64), one kernel launch over the same 3-axis grid (impl_cutile.py 92-100).
stages.note: Identical single-stage stencil; no padded copy, no unfold.

dependencies.triton: Output tiles independent; taps folded sequentially inside a program (impl_triton.py 33-41).

reduction_scan_sort.triton: Max over k*k taps in static kh-outer/kw-inner order starting from -inf via tl.maximum (impl_triton.py 30-41).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: Max over k*k taps in the same order starting from -inf via ct.maximum (impl_cutile.py 37-44).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Order-independent for non-NaN data; NaN semantics unspecified on both sides and never exercised (randn inputs).

precision.triton: Running tile in the input dtype (tl.full with input_ptr.dtype.element_ty, 30-31); no upcast; output in input dtype.
precision.cutile: Running tile in x3.dtype (37); no upcast; output in input dtype.
precision.note: No arithmetic; max is exact in any dtype; the contract permits a wider running type but does not require it.

preprocessing.triton: H_out/W_out/total_out arithmetic and the early empty return only (impl_triton.py 64-69); no copy/cast; nothing cached.
preprocessing.cutile: Same arithmetic and early return plus zero-copy .view to (N*C, H, W)/(N*C, H_out, W_out) (impl_cutile.py 55-64); nothing cached.
preprocessing.note: No device-side preprocessing on either side.

mutation.triton: No input written; output freshly allocated (impl_triton.py 71).
mutation.cutile: No input written; output freshly allocated (impl_cutile.py 62).

hardware_dispatch.triton: No architecture branch; kernel_size/stride/padding are tl.constexpr (impl_triton.py 16-18).
hardware_dispatch.cutile: No architecture branch; kernel_size/stride/padding are ConstInt (impl_cutile.py 24-26).
hardware_dispatch.note: Both specialise the kernel on the problem parameters (a mapping choice the contract leaves free); no hardware dispatch.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: N * C * H * H * dtype_size + N * C * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * dtype_size
fq_boundary.flops_expr: N * C * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * kernel_size ** 2
fq_boundary.note: config.yaml 21-28. Assumes W = H as the generator guarantees (tensors.py 486-487). Counts one read of the input, one write of the output and one comparison per tap per output; both run() bodies contain only metadata, an uninitialised output allocation and one kernel. Cache re-reads of overlapping windows are uncounted on both sides equally.
